definition: WellFounded of strict parthood on non-null objects. This is a mereological termination policy, not causal well-foundedness and not merely simple-part existence.
note: The chapter Step1p127 explicitly invokes termination; pp129–131 defend P2 qualitatively (fn186). Standard WellFounded is the classical order rendering of that termination reading; this is not a proof that it describes reality. Attribution clarification: ChapterVI Step1p127 INVOKES termination; it is not the literal original P2 atomicity premise. ChapterVII155–156 explicitly distinguishes atomism from terminating descent and adjusts P2 after the objection. Both claims attribute the invocation/adjusted commitment, not a proof of reality applicability or an inference from simple-part existence. The author expressly distinguishes this mereological condition from causal finitism.
